item.title: Version 1.3.96
item.description:
- Fixed content running off the right edge when the window is resized. The window background (a large "fill" photo) could be wider than the window and stretch the whole layout, cutting off the fifth action tile, the third column of cards and the right side of every screen. The background is now a non-layout .background clipped to the window.
- Gallery cards size by aspect ratio instead of a fixed height, and their photos no longer set the column width, so columns stay even and reflow as the window changes.
- Publish header stacks (title, then scrolling status pills, then buttons) in narrow windows, and the pills no longer wrap their text letter by letter.
